info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Acanthit Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Acanthit Laptop Details API allows users to submit comprehensive details about Acanthit laptops for catalog inclusion. This endpoint facilitates the registration of product specifications, features, and associated metadata, ensuring that customers have access to accurate and up-to-date product information. Common use cases include contributions from product managers and inventory teams looking to enhance the online catalog. By leveraging this API, businesses can streamline their product listing process, improving the overall shopping experience for end-users.

post.summary: Create details for the Acanthit laptop.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create and submit details specific to the Acanthit laptop. It supports providing all necessary information required to register or update the laptop's specifications in the system.
